Bobine

An AI video editor that cuts your footage in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Creators who post every day spend their evenings editing on a phone. Simple apps give amateur results, professional software takes months to learn, and cloud editors require uploading gigabytes over mobile data.

02

What it does

You choose a format (vlog, product launch, UGC, podcast clip and 11 others), add footage and music, and an agent plans the cut, edits, reviews and fixes it. Captions, titles, color and music levels are set automatically; you request changes in plain words. Export in 9:16 and 16:9. Cinéma generates AI scenes with a chosen camera, movement and light.

03

How it is built

Rendering runs in the browser with WebCodecs; only short text descriptions are sent to the AI. Cuts follow the beats of the music. Credits are reserved before each AI call and refunded if the call fails. The 13 demo edits in the gallery were made from licensed stock footage.
